# FFL Accelerator

FFL Accelerator is Coriolis's managed WooCommerce website for FFL dealers. We build the store on your domain and run it with you. If you leave, the website goes with you. Month to month. MSA at signup.

Publisher: Coriolis, LLC. Greenville, SC. Phone (279) 258-6771.

## What you get
A store on your domain. Hosting, design, FFL checkout, 21 distributor catalogs, register integration when you want it, email campaigns, and analytics including on-site search. Webmaster included. Backed by WP Engine's 99.95% uptime SLA.
